description: P6.6 real-repository generalization tasks over three immutable Git snapshots.

scenarios.task: Add a concise README subsection with the exact heading 'AI context handoff'. Explain that the AOS source repository produces the CLI distribution, downstream .aos stores project control data, and context remains provider-neutral.
scenarios.verification_command: if (-not (Select-String -Path 'README.md' -SimpleMatch '## AI context handoff' -Quiet)) { exit 1 }; node scripts/validate-aos.mjs

records.subject: AOS product and downstream boundary
records.content: README.md owns the user-facing handoff: AOS source builds the CLI distribution, while downstream repositories own their .aos project control data.

records.subject: AOS context consumer boundary
records.value: Context packages remain provider-neutral and do not grant authority to a consumer.

scenarios.task: Add one concise DESIGN.md paragraph with the exact heading 'Setup implementation ownership'. State that src/setup.rs orchestrates setup while src/extension.rs retains extension validation and lifecycle ownership; setup must not bypass Governance.
scenarios.verification_command: if (-not (Select-String -Path 'DESIGN.md' -SimpleMatch 'Setup implementation ownership' -Quiet)) { exit 1 }; node scripts/validate-aos.mjs

records.subject: setup orchestration owner
records.content: src/setup.rs owns setup planning and orchestration; it delegates bundled extension enablement through the accepted extension implementation.

records.subject: extension lifecycle owner
records.content: src/extension.rs owns manifest validation, lifecycle, Governance binding, scope checks, and immutable extension evidence.

scenarios.task: Strengthen the existing context smoke test with a regression assertion proving that authority_proposed appears exactly once in the output while the authoritative record remains selected. Use body.matches(...).count() and change only tests/cli_smoke.rs.

records.subject: context filtering implementation
records.content: Context filtering distinguishes authoritative selected records from proposed records withheld with authority_proposed.

records.subject: context regression coverage
records.value: The deterministic context smoke is the narrow regression target for selected and withheld records.

scenarios.task: Add the smallest CLI specification clarification under compact context: selected records retain source_reference, withheld records retain an explicit reason, and byte-budget enforcement is deterministic. Change only specifications/004-cli.md.

records.subject: compact context public contract
records.content: The CLI specification owns compact context provenance, withholding explanation, and deterministic byte-budget requirements.

records.subject: compact context implementation proof
records.value: CLI smoke tests verify source_reference retention, explicit withholding reasons, and deterministic budget behavior.

scenarios.task: Add one concise sentence to the P6.5 ROADMAP section stating exactly that consumer-adapter optimization does not close the P6.2 real-duration gate or activate P7.
scenarios.verification_command: if (-not (Select-String -Path 'ROADMAP.md' -SimpleMatch 'does not close the P6.2 real-duration gate or activate P7' -Quiet)) { exit 1 }; node scripts/validate-aos.mjs

records.subject: P6.5 maturity boundary
records.content: P6.5 is a consumer-adapter efficiency qualification and must not advance P6.2 elapsed time or P7 eligibility.

records.subject: P6.2 qualification state
records.value: P6.2 remains active on its pinned real-duration evidence lane.

scenarios.task: Add a concise implementation-status note with the exact heading 'Runtime evidence boundary'. State that implementation alignment alone cannot justify production-like or production readiness without current runtime evidence.
scenarios.verification_command: if (-not (Select-String -Path 'docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md' -SimpleMatch 'Runtime evidence boundary' -Quiet)) { exit 1 }; git diff --check

records.subject: TRENUX Rust readiness vocabulary
records.content: Implementation status owns maturity claims and separates implementation alignment from runtime and production evidence.

records.subject: TRENUX Rust current evidence boundary
records.value: Production-like and production readiness remain fail-closed without current runtime evidence.

scenarios.verification_command: if (-not (Select-String -Path 'docs/README.md' -SimpleMatch 'Dependency-safe implementation order' -Quiet)) { exit 1 }; git diff --check

records.subject: TRENUX Rust ownership navigation
